question.text: The PPM of Ganga Ventures Fund includes a section on conflict of interest procedures. Which of the following is a SEBI-mandated disclosure requirement regarding conflicts?

answer.text: A statement that no conflicts of interest exist or will ever arise
Procedures for identifying, managing, and disclosing conflicts of interest, including co-investment policies and related-party transactions
A list of all competitors of the fund manager
Personal trading records of the fund manager's employees

explanation.text: The Logic: Fund governance requires the AIF to put in place conflict policies and procedures, disclose conflicts, manage related-party transactions, and pay attention to co-investment opportunities. The PPM is expected to reflect that conflict-management framework — identification, management, mitigation and disclosure. The Trap: Option A pretends no conflicts can ever arise, which contradicts the governance framework that assumes conflicts will occur and must be managed. Options C and D point to a competitor list and personal trading records, neither of which is a recognised conflict-of-interest disclosure in the PPM. Note: The keyed option focuses on source-backed elements — conflict policy, related-party transactions, and co-investment governance — rather than a fully prescribed PPM checklist.
